simple.meaning: as far (or long , or much ) as , whether of space ( even unto ) or time ( during , while , until ) or degree ( equally with )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַד (H5704) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: prep.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 1263 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַד (ʻad) means as far (or long , or much ) as , whether of space ( even unto ) or time ( during , while , until ) or degree ( equally with ) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 27.

definitions.short: as far (or long , or much ) as , whether of space ( even unto ) or time ( during , while , until ) or degree ( equally with )
definitions.usage: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ( as) yet.
definitions.full: H5704. ad III. עַד , in poetry עֲדֵי ( Num 24:20 , 24 ; Psa 104:23 ; 147:6 ; Job 7:4 ; 20:5 , and in עַד עֲדֵי Isa 26:4 ; 65:18 ; Psa 83:18 ; 92:8 ; 132:12 ; 132:14 :compare עֲלֵי אֱלֵי, ), preposition as far as, even to, up to, until, while (Aramaic עד , Sabean עדי עד, , Mordtm ZMG xxx (1876), 27 ; DHM xxxvii (1883), 414 , Assyrian adi Dl § 81 a (Arabic is except ); perh akin to pass on, advance to , Kö ii. 304, 309: עֲדֵי probably from ground-form ±¦d¦y , Ol 428, 431 Kö ii. 309 ff. ; but Lag Sym. ii. 101-3, Mitth. i. 231 f. , as plur. like אַחֲרֵי ); — with suffix עָדַי Num 23:18 +, עָדֶיךָ Micah 4:8 +, etc., עָֽדיֵכֵם Job 32:12 ; 2Kin 9:18 עַדהֵֿם occurs; — as far as, even to (differing from אֶל in that the limit is included, as in Arabic Fl Kl. Schr. i. 402 f. ): I. preposition 1. of space ; — a. Gen 11:31 חרן עד ויבאו as far as Haran, 12:6 ; 13:3 , 12 + often, Isa 8:8 יגעַ צואר עד , 15:4 קולם נשׁמע יהץ עד , 25:12 ; 26:5 ; Psa 36:6 שׁחקים עד אמונתך , 69:2 נפשׁ עד מים דאו (compare Jonah 2:6 ; Micah 1:9 ; Jer 4:10 , 18 ), Jer 90:3 דַּכָּא עַד אֱנוֺשׁ תָּשֵׁד Job 11:7 , etc.; pregnantly Psa 118:27 וגו עַד חָג ׳אִסְדוּ bind . . . (and lead) up to . . . ; Isa 57:9 מֵרָחוק עַד even to afar ( מִן 1c ); with the goal a person , Exod 22:8 שְׁנֵיהֶם דְבַר יָבאֹ האלהים עד , 1Sam 9:9 ; Psa 65:3 יָבאֹוּ כָלבָּֿשָׂר עָדֶיךָ Isa 45:24 ; Job 4:5 , י עַד ׳שׁוּב Hosea 14:2 al. (see שׁוּב , stronger than אֶליֿ ׳שׁוּב ); in poetry Num 24:20 אֹבֵד עֲדֵי וְאַחֲדִיתוֺ shall be even unto destruction, shall issue in destruction, 24:24 ; rarely with verbs of attending , עַד הֶאֱזִין 23:18 , עַד הִתְבּוֺנֵן Job 32:12 ; 38:18 (usually אֶל ). Before another perp., 1Sam 7:11 ל מִתַּחַת ׳עַד 1Kin 4:12 מֵעַל עַד ל, מֵעֵבֶר ׳עַד Ezek 41:20 , לִפְנֵי עַד Est 4:2 , and even (si vera. l.) אְלֵיהֶם עַד 2Kin 9:20 :compare נֶגֶד עַד Neh 3:16 , 26 , נֹכַח עַד Judg 19:10 +. b. In the combination (וְ)עַד ֗֗֗ מִן , as Gen 10:19 עַזָּה עַד ֗֗֗ מצידון from Sidon . . . as far as Gaza + often (see מן 5a ); and idiomatic, not of actual space, but of class of objects , to express the idea of both... and , as Gen 19:4 זָקִן וְעַד מִנַּעַר from young to old (inclusively) = both young and old (see מִן 5b ); without מִן , even to = including , Lev 11:42 ; Num 8:4 even to (i. e. including) it base and its flower, compare 1Sam 18:4 . 2 Of time: a. (a) even to, until Gen 8:5 even to the 10th month, Exod 12:6 unto the 14th day, etc., 12:15 ; 12:18 , etc.; היום עד unto this day , Gen 19:37-38 , הזה היום עד 26:33 ; Genesis 32:33, both + often; יום עד followed by infinitive Exod 40:37 ; Josh 6:10 ; Judg 18:30 ; בקר עד till morning, Exod 12:10 + (15 t.), הבקר עד 16:23 + (11 t.); so (ה)ערב עד 18:13-14 , +, in poetry ערב עֲרֵי Psa 104:23 ; עוֺלָם עַד Gen 13:15 + often; מְּעָמִים שֶׁבַע עַד 2Kin 4:35 ; וָדוֺר דּוֺר עַד Isa 13:20 ; see also בְּלִי , and בִּלְתִּי , near the end and followed by another preposition, Lev 23:16 הַשַּׁבָּת מִמָּחֳרַת עַד , Neh 13:9 הַשַּׁבָּת אַחַר עַד . With the force of against , Judg 6:31 הַבֹּקֶר עַד יוּמַת ; compare (b) end. (b) followed by infinitive, both of past time, as Gen 8:7 ; Genesis 32:35 הַשַּׁחַר עֲלוֺת עַד , 33:3 ; 34:5 , and especially future time, as 3:19 שׁוּבְךָ עַד until thy returning, 19:22 ; 27:45 ; Deut 7:20 , 23 ; 20:20 ; 22:2 ; 28:20 , 22 , — both + often; compare בּוֺשׁ עַד Judg 3:25 +; ֗֗֗ תֹּם עַד Lev 25:29 10 t.; תֻּמָּם עַד Deut 2:15 +; כַּלֵּה עַד 2Kin 13:17 , 19 ; Ezek 19:14 ; כַּלּוֺתָ(םׅ עַד 1Sam 15:18 ; Jer 9:15 +; הַבֹּקֶר אוֺר עַד Judg 16:2 +; also in אֹתָם הִשְׁמִדְךָ עַד Deut 7:24 (compare 28:48 ; Josh 11:14 ; 1Kin 15:29 ; 2Kin 3:25 ; 10:17 ; 24:20 [|| Jer 52:3 הִשְׁלִיכוֺ ]; on the anomalous ׳הִ , see Dr, read probably ׳הַ ); and most probably compare Kö iii. 583 ) in שָׂרִיד (לָהֶם) לוֺ הִשְׁאִיר בִּלְתִּי עַד Deut 3:3 (see Dr), + 5 t. (see above), read probably הַשְׁאִיר . With the force of towards the end of, against , especially in בֹּאָ(םׅ עַד , Gen 43:25 ; Exod 22:25 ; Num 10:21 בֹּאָם עַד המשׁכן את והקימו used to set up the tabernacle against their coming, 2Kin 16:11 ; Ezek 33:22 ; compare 2Sam 17:22 . Elliptical Judg 16:2 וַהֲרַגְנוּהוּ הַבֹּקֶד אוֺד עַד (wait) till the morning dawn, and we slay him! (GFM; Dr § 115 ). (c) with various adverbs of time. (q. v.) as עַתָּה עַד כֵּן, עַד כֹּה, עַד הֵנָּה, עַד מָתַי, עַד עַדמָֿה, אָנָה, עַד , compare פְעָמִים כַּמֶּה עַד (see מָה 4b ). ( d ) to suffest also degree (compare 3 ), מָקוֺם אֵין עַד until there is no place Isa 5:8 , מִסְמָּר אֵין עַד Psa 40:13 ; Job 5:9 ; 9:10 ; compare Lev 26:18 וְאִםעַֿדאֵֿלֶּה and if even up to these things , even the end of all these punishment, you do not hearken to me. b. During (rare; prop, as far as the limit indicated, including the time previous, compare ἔως : so often Aramaic עַד , , while ), 2Kin 9:22 what is peace אִיזֶבֶל זְנוּנֵי עַד during , etc.,? Job 20:5 רָ֑גַע עֲדֵי during a moment; followed by infinitive Judg 3:26 הִתְמַהְמְהָם עַד during their delaying, Exod 33:22 ; Job 7:19 רֻקִּי בִּלְעִי עַד Jonah 4:2 . 3 Of degree , to suggest a higher or the highest; as מְאֹד עַד even to muchness, i.e. exceedingly (see מְאֹד ), מְהֵרָה עַד even to haste Psa 147:15 ; Est 5:6 וְתֵעָשׂ הַמַּלְכוּת עַדחֲֿצִי וּמַהבֻּֿקָּשָׁתֵךְ , 5:3 ; 7:2 . See also לְ עַד , below. With a negative, to express not even as much as , Deut 2:5 רָ֑גֶל כַּף מִדְרַךְ עַד מארצם לכם אתן לא , and with אֶחָד , Exod 9:7 עַדאֶֿחָד ֗֗֗ מֵת לֹא , simil. 14:28 ; Judg 4:16 ; 2Sam 17:22 (read אֶחָד for ׃אַחַד see Dr). Sts. almost = Latin adeo , 1Sam 2:5 (si vera lectio) שׁבעה ילדה עֲקָרָה עַד even to the barren, she hath borne seven, i.e. even the barren hath, etc., Job 25:5 יאהיל ולא עדיָֿרֵחַ הן , Hag 2:19 . In comparisons, to the degree of, even like (rare), Nahum 1:10 סְבֻכִים סִירִים עַד (text dubious) entangled even like thorns, 1Chr 4:27 יהודה בני עד הִרְבּוּ לא did not multiply to the degree of (i.e. like ), etc. compare. 2Sam 23:19 בָא לֹא הַשְּׁלשָׁה עַד did not attain (in prowess) unto the three. II. conjunction 1. until ; — a אֲשֶׁר עַד until that: (a) with perfect, of past time , Exod 32:20 דָּק אשׁר עד ויטחן ( Deut 9:21 ), 2:14 עָבַרְנוּ אשׁר עד , Josh 3:17 ; 8:26 ; Judg 4:24 ; 1Kin 10:7 ( 2Chr 9:6 ), 2Kin 17:20 , 23 ; 21:16 ; with suggestion of degree , 1Sam 30:4 (followed by אֵין ), 1Kin 17:17 ; rarely of future time (the 'future perfect,' Dr § 17 ), 2Sam 17:13 (of degree), Ezek 34:21 So - שֶׁ עַד (often in Late Hebrew; see שֶׁ ) Judg 5:7 ; Song 3:4 (twice in verse); כִּי עַד Gen 26:13 מְאֹד כִּיגָֿדַל עַד , 41:49 ; 2Sam 23:10 ; 2Chr 26:15 ; and (of future time) אִם אֲשֶׁר עַד Gen 28:15 ; Num 32:17 ; Isa 6:11 . ( b ) with imperfect, usually of future time, Gen 27:44 אָחִיךָ חֲמַר תָּשׁוּב אֲשֶׁר עַד , 29:8 ; Exod 23:30 ; 24:14 ; Lev 22:4 ; Num 11:20 ; 20:17 ; 1Sam 22:3 ; Hosea 5:15 +; rarely of past time, Jonah 4:5 יראה אשׁר עד till he should see, Eccl 2:3 . So (of the future) - שֶׁ עַד Song 2:7 , 17 ; 3:5 ; 4:6 ; 8:4 ; Psa 123:2 ; and כִּי עַד Gen 49:10 שִׁילֹה כִּייָֿבאֹ עַד . b. עַד alone, until: ( a ) with perfect, of past time, Josh 2:22 ; 4:23 עַדעָֿבַרְנוּ , 1Sam 20:41 הִגְדִּיל דָּוִד עַד , 2Sam 21:10 ; 1Kin 11:16 ; Ezek 28:15 ; of the future (rare), 2Kin 7:3 מָ֑תְנוּ עַד , Ezek 39:15 ; Dan 11:36 זָ֑עַם כָּלָה עַד . So סִם עַד (of the future), Gen 24:19 , 33 ; Isa 30:17 ; Ruth 2:21 . ( b ) with imperfect, of future time, 1Sam 1:22 (elliptic: compare Judg 16:2 , 12a ( b ) end ), Isa 22:14 ; 26:20 ; 32:15 ; 62:1 , 7 ; Psa 57:2 ; 71:18 ; Job 27:5 +; of the past (rare), Exod 15:16 עמך יעבור עד , 15:16 ; Josh 10:13 (poetry) אוֺיְבָיו גּוֺי יִקֹּם עַד , Psa 73:17 . — N.B. In poetry, עַד is sometimes used to mark not an absolute close, but an epoch or turning-point, in the future, as 110:1 (see De) לְרַגְלֶיךָ הֲדֹם אֹיְבֶיךָ אָשִׁית עַד , Hosea 10:12 ; Job 14:6 (but see 3 ); after a negative clause , Gen 49:10 ; Num 23:24 ; Isa 42:4 ; Psa 71:18 ; 112:8 ; Job 8:21 (but read probably with Ew Hi Di Du al. עֹד he will yet , etc., understanding 8:20 as present, not future). 2 While (rare: compare 12 b): — a. with perfect, 1Sam 14:19 שׁאול דִּבֶּר עד while Saul spake. b. with imperfect, Psa 141:10 אֶעֱבֹר עַד אָנֹכִי יַחד while I at the same time pass by. c. with participle, Job 1:18 מְדַבֵּר זֶה עַד (but read probably עֹד , as 1:16 ; 1:17 ), Neh 7:3 . d. - שֶׁ עַד (without verb) Song 1:12 . So לֹא עַד while not = ere yet (of past time) Prov 8:26 אדץ עשׂה לא עד (so לָא עַד , , often, e.g. Gen 24:15 ᵑ7 , Matt 1:18 ); and לא אשׁר עד (of the future) Eccl 12:1-2 , 6 (compare Talmud דְּלָא עַד , Mishna עַד שֶׁלּאֹ ). 3 Of degree, to the point that, so that even (rare), Isa 47:7 Thou saidst, I shall be for ever a lady, לִבֵךְ עַל אֵלֶּה שַׂמְתְּ לֹא עַד to the point that (going so far in thy pride that) thou didst not, etc. (but Hi Che Du al. join עַד גְּבֶרֶת I shall be for ever, a lady perpetually ; see I. עַד ); Job 14:6 (Di De Bu Du) to the point that he may enjoy, etc., Isa 22:14 (Du). In Josh 17:14 י ֵבּרְכַנִי כֹּה ׳עַד אֲשֶׁר עַד , read אֲשֶׁר עַל because that (Ges Buhl; compare Di). III. לְ עַד , a strengthened form for עַד , found chiefly in Chronicles, Ezra, and occurring in most of the above senses. Thus 1 of space: עַד חֲמָת לְבוֺא Josh 13:5 ; Judg 3:3 ; 1Chr 13:5 , ל ׳עד מִדְבָּ֫רָה 5:9 , ל ׳עד מצרים 2Chr 16:8 ; הַגָּ֑יְא לְמִזְרַהּ עַד 1Chr 4:39 , לַמְצָד עַד 12:17 ; לִגְרָר עַד 2Chr 14:12 ; לַשָּׁמַיִם עַד 28:9 ; Ezra 9:6 . 2 Of time: לעולם עד 1Chr 23:25 ; 28:7 ; עַד לְמֵרָחוֺק 2Chr 26:15 ; Ezra 3:13 ; 9:4 הערב למנחת עד ; הַזֶּה לַדָּבָר עַד 10:14 probably during (Keil Ges Be with regard to , strengthened for לְ ); followed by infinitive הַמִּנְחָה לַעֲלוֺת עַד 1Kin 18:29 ; לִכְלוֺת עַד 1Chr 28:20 ; 2Chr 29:28 ; לְכַלֵּה עַד 24:10 ; 31:1 ; להשׁחית עד 26:16 ; לָמוּת עַד 32:24 (|| 2Kin 20:1 לָמוּת alone); Ezra 10:14 להשׁיב עד . 3 Of degree: גָדוֺל לְמַחֲנֶה עַד even unto (till there was) a great camp, 1Chr 12:23 ; לְמַ֫עְלָה עַד = exceedingly 2Chr 16:12 ; 17:12 ; 26:8 ; לִמְאֹד עַד 16:14 ; לְשִׂמְחָה עַד 29:30 לָרֹב עַד 2Chron 31:30; מַרְמֵּא לְאֵין עַד 36:16 .
